scripts.check: biome check && bun run check:types && bun scripts/check-boundaries.ts
scripts.check:types: tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.node.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/protocol/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/game-core/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/creature/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/ai/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/platform/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p apps/web/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p apps/server/tsconfig.json
scripts.build: bun run check:types && bun --cwd=apps/web run build
scripts.deploy:staging: bun run build && wrangler deploy --config apps/server/wrangler.jsonc --env staging
scripts.deploy:production: bun run build && wrangler deploy --config apps/server/wrangler.jsonc --env production
